messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-78921 - api-runtime-prod p95 latency spike > 1200ms (router.latency.p95). Triggered at 2026-03-14T10:12:02Z. Link: <https://pagerduty.example/PD-78921>

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-78921 created and routed to schedule 'eng-oncall' -> @alyssa (primary). Priority: P2.

alyssa: acked. I'm on it. pulled up the latency dashboard — p95 ~1.4s on batch-router shards. No large 5xx bump. @devon can you join? might be noisy KV misses.

devon: joining. looking at traces now. most of the tail is coming from requests with cold KV lookups right before token generation. QPS steady. a few nodes show `kv_miss` spikes.

samir: oncoming. prewarm script didn't run on 3 pods after last deploy. running quick scale and prewarm: 
```
kubectl scale deploy/router -n prod --replicas=12
./ops/prewarm_kv.sh --prefix router/* --timeout 30s
```
Logs: `2026-03-14T10:13:01Z kv_warmup miss=142 hit=3 -> prewarm started`

alyssa: noted. I'm also temporarily routing traffic away from legacy-proxy -> dedicated-pool to reduce extra load: `rbac disable-route legacy-proxy` (rolling, few seconds).

incident-bot: Escalation policy: No escalation needed, incident acknowledged by @alyssa at 3150001135.

devon: after scale + prewarm latency p95 down to ~380ms within two minutes. traces show warmup hits increasing, miss rate dropping. 

samir: prewarm finished on all nodes. final KV log: `kv_warmup miss=5 hit=257`. Confirming memory usage nominal.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert PD-78921 auto-resolved at 2026-03-14T10:14:50Z — metric returned below threshold for configured evaluation window.

alyssa: marking this as resolved in-thread. No customer-facing errors (0 5xx increase, no user reports). Will open a follow-up ticket: INF-3789 to add prewarm to rolling deploys and tweak alert noise.

devon: +1. I created a draft PR to add a 3m suppression for single-sample p95 spikes and to surface kv_miss ratio in the alert body: https://github.com/redwood/infr/PR/1245 :thumbsup:

samir: leaving a note in infra runbook about verifying prewarm hooks on deploys. Also adding a small metric to watch `kv_warmup_success_rate`.

alyssa: thanks team. handoff: oncall->end. no escalation to SRE required. I'll include timeline in INF-3789 and drop a short blurb in #incidents. :white_check_mark:

samir: :thumbsup: closing thread.
